_comment: Upstream repositories worth reading alongside this one. Fetched on demand by scripts/fetch-references.sh into references/ (gitignored) — never vendored, so they stay current and their licenses stay theirs. Sizes are upstream repo size as reported by the GitHub API; a --depth 1 clone is usually much smaller.

repos.name: claude-skills
repos.why: The origin of 149 of this repo's 168 skills. Read it for the full upstream set, which is larger and updated more often than the snapshot here.
repos.description: 345+ skills, 30+ agents and 70+ commands across engineering, marketing, product, compliance and C-level advisory.

repos.name: anthropic-skills
repos.license_note: Each skill carries its own LICENSE.txt. Not MIT — check before redistributing.
repos.why: Anthropic's own skills, and the reference for how a skill should be structured. The 16 under skills/anthropic-official/ come from here.
repos.description: Official Agent Skills: pdf, docx, xlsx, pptx, skill-creator, frontend-design, mcp-builder and more.

repos.name: claude-code-config
repos.why: The security-first end of the spectrum. Its permission deny-list patterns are the basis for the ones in templates/global/settings.json.
repos.description: Trail of Bits' opinionated Claude Code defaults, documentation and workflows.

repos.name: claude-code-showcase
repos.why: Source of the skill-eval hook system and the GitHub Actions workflows in this repo. Worth reading end to end as a complete project config.
repos.description: A full project configuration example: hooks, skills, agents, commands and CI workflows.

repos.name: claude-code-settings
repos.why: Compact and well-organised. A good model for how to lay out commands and agents without the volume of the larger collections.
repos.description: Curated skills, sub-agents and config templates — research, image generation, GitHub automation.

repos.name: awesome-claude-code
repos.why: The broadest index of the ecosystem — skills, agents, status lines, tooling, plugins. Start here when looking for something that is not in this repo.
repos.description: Hand-picked collection of Claude Code resources.

repos.name: composio-awesome-skills
repos.why: Strong on app-integration skill patterns — how a skill wraps a third-party API cleanly.
repos.description: Curated Claude Skills, resources and tools for customizing Claude workflows.

repos.name: travisvn-awesome-skills
repos.why: Smaller and more Claude Code-specific than the other lists.
repos.description: Curated Claude Skills, focused on Claude Code.

repos.name: behisecc-awesome-skills
repos.why: Another skills index. Overlaps the two above; clone it if you are surveying comprehensively.
repos.description: A curated list of Claude Skills.

repos.name: claude-templates
repos.why: Small and readable. Useful if the larger template sets are more structure than you want.

repos.name: claude-code-templates
repos.why: A CLI that configures and monitors Claude Code — a different approach to the same problem this repo's install.sh solves. Large: 219 MB upstream, so it is opt-in.
repos.description: CLI tool for configuring and monitoring Claude Code.
